situation: You open the banking app, and thirty thousand dollars of savings is gone. Your husband has just walked in.

scenario.title: Where Did the Money Go?
scenario.setting: A family kitchen, 9 pm, a phone on the table, dinner gone cold.
scenario.user_goal: Find out where the money went and what you do now.
user_knows: The savings were for your child's school
He has been on edge for weeks

cast.name: Jason
cast.appearance: Man about 42, loosened tie, tired eyes, keys still in his hand
cast.voice: Jokes it off, then defensive, then very quiet
cast.goal: Buy time until the money comes back
cast.secret: He put it all into a friend's crypto scheme, which froze withdrawals two weeks ago
cast.reveal_when: You ask directly twice where the money went, or ask calmly what he's afraid of telling you
red_lines: Won't lie once directly asked twice

cast.name: Your mother-in-law
cast.appearance: Woman about 68, neat short hair, patterned blouse, side dishes in a bag
cast.voice: Sweet on the surface, always takes her son's side
cast.secret: She gave him money last month too, and he told her not to tell you

cast.name: Greg
cast.appearance: Man about 44, shiny jacket, seen in a video call on a phone propped against a bottle
cast.goal: Stop you from going to the police
cast.secret: There's a Friday deadline to get some of it back and he hasn't told anyone

scenario.opening_line: Hey, what's—why's it so quiet? Did you eat?

events.description: The doorbell rings. His mother lets herself in with side dishes.
events.shot: An older woman with a bag of side dishes stands in the kitchen beside the man.

events.description: His phone rings on the table. He answers on speaker by mistake.
events.shot: A phone propped on the table shows a video call; the man stares at it, frozen.

events.description: Your husband sits down and puts both hands flat on the table.
events.shot: The man sits at the kitchen table with both palms flat, looking at you.

success_criteria: Gets the truth out of him
